page_title: SAL 0-1 LEC | Salernitana v Lecce 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Fabio Maresca is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Fabio Maresca's book.
90+5' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) and Patrick Dorgu perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
90+2' Konstantinos Manolas (Salernitana) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
90+1' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) steps up to send the ball in.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentin Gendrey leaves the pitch and Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) comes on.
89' Toma Basic (Salernitana) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
87' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Benoit Costil makes a comfortable save.
86' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
83' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
82' Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
79' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' Here's the change. Nikola Krstovic leaves the pitch and Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.
76' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

75' Iron Gomis (Salernitana) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Wladimiro Falcone sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
75' A dangerous looking corner kick from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is cleared to safety by the defence.
74' Simy (Salernitana) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wladimiro Falcone.
73' Lecce have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
73' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
71' Fabio Liverani has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) replacing Giulio Maggiore.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Nicola Sansone (Lecce) coming on for Antonino Gallo.
70' Salernitana hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) serves up a nice cross, but Wladimiro Falcone punches the ball away.
67' Fabio Liverani prepares a substitution. Norbert Gyomber is replaced by Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana).
67' Substitution. Loum Tchaouna did his best and is replaced by Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana).
63' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
59' Some great controlled play and passing from Lecce. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
54' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
53' Fabio Liverani decides to make a substitution. Shon Weissman will be replaced by Simy (Salernitana).
53' Lassana Coulibaly goes off the pitch and Iron Gomis (Salernitana) comes on.
53' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
49' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
47' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
46' Luca Gotti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) comes on the pitch for Remi Oudin.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Benoit Costil (Salernitana).
45' Yellow card. Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Toma Basic (Salernitana) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
42' It seemed like Toma Basic (Salernitana) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
39' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
36' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Toma Basic (Salernitana) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
33' Salernitana have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.

32' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
30' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Benoit Costil pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
30' A yellow card for bad language! Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
28' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
25' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
25' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Wladimiro Falcone.
21' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
20' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
17' Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him, it's into his own goal!
15' A shot from the edge of the box by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
14' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts superbly to deny him.
14' Toma Basic (Salernitana) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
10' Lecce are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
9' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
6' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
3' A pass by Konstantinos Manolas (Salernitana) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lecce.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Lecce will kick the game off.
Fabio Maresca will supervise the game today.
